integrity: General all-discount assertion established by an explicit exact rational resolvent identity and positive denominators; deterministic-deadline exception is certified with rational uniformization and a rigorous remainder bound. Historical priority remains provisional; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two identical patches, no exogenous immigration, independent Markov habitat/demographic clocks, a specific initial occupancy, pulse probability at most one, and nominal rather than realized dispersal matching. Exponential-deadline order is not fixed-time stochastic order. No empirical calibration or network-size extension.
title: Two-patch disturbance-triggered dispersal dominates every exponential deadline, but not every fixed deadline
